description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted a Training and Education/End-of-Life Care joint Committee meeting. The Chairs, Brenda Burgard and Larry Leeman, co-facilitated the meeting. The End-of-Life Care committee presented its scopes, responsibilities and suggested recommendations to this point. The second half of the meeting discussed proposed basic requirements for the roles of the diagnostic clinician, lead practitioner and facilitator.
